questions.text: Which of the following is the correct way to declare a function in JavaScript?
What happens when you call (or execute) a function?
distractors: The code inside the function will run and `null` will always be returned.
Nothing will happen when you call a function.

questions.answer: The code inside the function will run and a value will be returned.

questions.text: Which of the following is the correct way to call a function?

distractors: The `return` keyword will execute the function.
The `return` keyword will throw a type error.

questions.answer: The `return` keyword returns a value from the function.
